questions.prompt: Request 1 said "My name is Priya." Request 2 holds only "What is my name?". Why does the model not know the name?
options: The API key changed between the requests
The model keeps nothing between requests, and request 2 does not contain the name
The model forgets names on purpose
Request 2 was too large for the context window
questions.explanation: A stateless model answers from what one request contains. Request 2 has no earlier message, so the name is not there.

questions.prompt: The chat function has been called 3 times. How many messages does the third request send?
questions.explanation: Before the third request the list holds 2 user and 2 assistant messages from the first two calls, plus the new user message: 5 in all.

questions.prompt: What is the cost of a stateless model for your program?
options: Each request sends the earlier tokens again, so you pay for them again
The provider charges for storing your conversation
The model can only answer one question per day
The program cannot see the reply
questions.explanation: Because the model remembers nothing, every request repeats the conversation so far. Those tokens count and are charged in every request.
